package com.cricketsim.logic

import kotlin.random.Random

/**
 * The match referees (patch 132). Every match in the game has one: Match info says "Match referee: X.", and in a career match of an international series or tournament
 * or of a franchise league the toss presenter names him in his welcome. The names are real match referees (a name and nothing else is used). A career match always
 * gets the same referee ([forMatch], from the competition and the fixture, so the toss and Match info agree); any other match picks one at random ([pick]).
 * The toss presenter has one recorded line for each name ("Today's match referee is ..."), numbered from 1 in the order of [NAMES] (clip toss_ref_N).
 */
object MatchReferees {
    val NAMES: List<String> = listOf(
        "Ranjan Madugalle",
        "Javagal Srinath",
        "Andy Pycroft",
        "Richie Richardson",
        "Chris Broad",
        "David Boon",
        "Jeff Crowe",
        "Roshan Mahanama",
        "Graeme Labrooy",
        "Mike Procter",
        "Clive Lloyd",
        "Gundappa Viswanath",
        "Raman Subba Row",
        "John Reid"
    )

    fun pick(): String = NAMES[Random.nextInt(NAMES.size)]

    /** The same referee every time for the same [key] (a competition and a fixture). */
    fun forMatch(key: String): String = NAMES[Math.floorMod(key.hashCode(), NAMES.size)]

    /** The clip number of a referee (1 to [NAMES].size), 0 if the name is not one of them. */
    fun indexOf(name: String): Int = NAMES.indexOf(name) + 1
}

/** What the captains did at the toss of a career match when the player is not the captain. */
private class CareerTossOutcome(
    val result: TossResult,
    val text: String,
    val callerIsUser: Boolean,
    val call: CoinSide,
    val coin: CoinSide,
    val userWon: Boolean
)

/**
 * The toss of a career match when the player is not the captain: the captains do it. The screen only says who flips the coin, who calls, what it
 * landed on and who chose to bat or bowl, and the player continues to the match. (Away captain flips, home captain calls: [TossRoles.HOME_TEAM_CALLS].)
 *
 * With a [referee] (international series and tournaments and franchise leagues only, patch 132) and the clips in the audio pack the toss presentation plays
 * (ui/match/TossShow.kt): the presenter's welcome and the match referee, the call, the coin, the winner's answer, the other captain's answer, the closing; the
 * phone then says the result as before. "Start the match" cuts the voices off.
 */
@Composable
fun CareerTossScreen(userXI: Team, oppXI: Team, userIsHome: Boolean, onDone: (TossResult) -> Unit, onBack: () -> Unit, referee: String? = null) {
    val services = LocalGameServices.current
    val show = remember(referee) { TossShow.create(services?.sound, referee) }
    val toss = remember {
        val home = if (userIsHome) userXI else oppXI
        val away = if (userIsHome) oppXI else userXI
        val caller = if (!TossRoles.CAREER_HOME_CALLS) (if (Random.nextBoolean()) home else away) else if (TossRoles.HOME_TEAM_CALLS) home else away
        val flipper = if (caller === home) away else home
        val call = if (Random.nextBoolean()) CoinSide.HEADS else CoinSide.TAILS
        val coin = if (Random.nextBoolean()) CoinSide.HEADS else CoinSide.TAILS
        val callWord = if (call == CoinSide.HEADS) "heads" else "tails"
        val coinWord = if (coin == CoinSide.HEADS) "heads" else "tails"
        val winner = if (call == coin) caller else flipper
        val decision = if (Random.nextBoolean()) TossDecision.BAT else TossDecision.BOWL
        val text = "The ${flipper.name} captain flips the coin. The ${caller.name} captain calls $callWord. It lands on $coinWord. " +
            "${winner.name} won the toss and chose to ${if (decision == TossDecision.BAT) "bat" else "bowl"} first."
        CareerTossOutcome(
            result = TossResult(winnerId = winner.id, decision = decision),
            text = text,
            callerIsUser = caller.id == userXI.id,
            call = call,
            coin = coin,
            userWon = winner.id == userXI.id
        )
    }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (show != null) {
            // The welcome, the match referee and the invitation to call, before the coin goes up.
            show.play(show.opening(userFlips = false))
            show.waitUntilDone()
        }
        services?.sound?.playCoinFlip()
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(900)
        if (show != null) {
            show.play(show.afterCoin(toss.callerIsUser, toss.call, toss.coin, toss.userWon) + show.afterDecision(toss.userWon, toss.result.decision))
            show.waitUntilDone()
        }
        services?.announceSpoken(toss.text)
    }
    DisposableEffect(show) { onDispose { show?.stop() } }
    BackHandler(onBack = { show?.stop(); onBack() })
    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
        OutlinedButton(onClick = { show?.stop(); onBack() }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text("Back") }
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text("The toss", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.semantics { heading() })
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Text(
            text = toss.text,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
            // With the presentation the phone announces it after the voices, so a screen reader does not talk over them.
            modifier = if (show != null) Modifier else Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }
        )
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
        Button(onClick = { show?.stop(); onDone(toss.result) }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 56.dp)) { Text("Start the match") }
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prints every clip id of the toss presentation (patch 132), one per line, for tools/fetch_audio.sh.

The clips are made by the web app's toss_tts_generate endpoint (the presenter, the user's captain in the career press conference's player voice, the opposition
captain in another voice) and live at /_cdn/toss/<id>.mp3. The ids are the ones ui/match/TossShow.kt builds; the referee numbers follow logic/MatchReferees.kt (14 names).
"""
ids = []
ids += [f"toss_w_{i}" for i in range(1, 5)]                      # the welcome
ids += [f"toss_ref_{i}" for i in range(1, 15)]                   # "Today's match referee is ..." (one per referee)
ids += [f"toss_inv_call_{i}" for i in range(1, 4)]               # the invitation to call heads or tails
ids += [f"toss_inv_flip_{i}" for i in range(1, 4)]               # the invitation to the user to flip the coin
ids += [f"toss_res_h_{i}" for i in range(1, 3)]                  # "It's heads"
ids += [f"toss_res_t_{i}" for i in range(1, 3)]                  # "It's tails"
for group in ("qw_user", "qw_opp", "qs_user", "qs_opp"):         # the question to the winner and to the other captain
    ids += [f"toss_{group}_{i}" for i in range(1, 4)]
ids += [f"toss_end_{i}" for i in range(1, 3)]                    # the closing
for who in ("user", "opp"):                                      # the captains: the call, the decision, the answer after losing
    ids += [f"toss_{who}_heads", f"toss_{who}_tails"]
    ids += [f"toss_{who}_bat_{i}" for i in (1, 2)] + [f"toss_{who}_bowl_{i}" for i in (1, 2)]
    ids += [f"toss_{who}_lose_{i}" for i in (1, 2, 3)]
print("\n".join(ids))

# Toss presentation and match referees (patch 132)

## Match referees, everywhere
Every match has a **match referee** (`MatchState.referee`, `logic/MatchReferees.kt`, 14 real referees' names, a name and nothing else): **Match info** says "Match referee: X." in the Teams section, in a normal match, a tournament, every level of career mode. A career match always gets the same referee for the same fixture (`MatchReferees.forMatch`, so the toss and Match info agree); any other match picks one at random when it starts; a saved match without one gets one when it is loaded.

## The toss presentation (career mode, international and franchise leagues only)
In a career match of an **international series or tournament** or of a **franchise league** (nowhere else: not state, club, school, college, and not the normal game), the toss (the screen where you call and choose, or, when you are not the captain, the screen that tells you what the captains did) has a **presenter** and both captains speaking, recorded (`ui/match/TossShow.kt`):
1. the presenter welcomes everyone, **names the match referee** ("Today's match referee is ...") and invites the captain to call heads or tails (or you to flip the coin);
2. the caller says "Heads!" or "Tails!", the presenter says what the coin showed and **asks the captain who won the toss** for his decision and thinking;
3. he **answers** (bat or bowl); the presenter **asks the other captain** how he sees it; he answers; the presenter closes.
**Voices:** the presenter is an excited, authoritative commentator; **your captain speaks in the same voice as the player in the career press conference** (Charlie); the **opposition captain in another voice** (Eric). The lines are generic (no team names): after the voices the phone still says who won and what they chose. Continue / Start the match cuts the voices off. With the clips missing, sound effects off, or any other match, the toss goes on exactly as before (and the old toss commentary plays instead of the presentation).

## The presenter's voice
The web app's `toss_tts_generate` endpoint tries the Indian-accented sports commentators "Shaurya" and "Viraj" from the ElevenLabs voice library first, then the premade "Harry - Fierce Warrior". **Library voices need a paid ElevenLabs plan** (a free plan refuses them over the API), so on a free plan the presenter is Harry. Upgrading the plan and running the generation again (same clip ids) switches the whole presentation to the commentator voice. The voices were chosen by description and not heard by the assistant.

## Clips
60 clips (`tools/toss_clip_ids.py`): the presenter's welcome (4), one referee line per referee (14), invitations (3 + 3), coin results (2 + 2), questions (12), closings (2); each captain's call (2), decisions (4) and answers after losing (3). Fetched by "Fetch audio into the app" from `/_cdn/toss/<id>.mp3`.

## Not done
Names of the captains and teams in the spoken lines, the presenter in the toss of the game's own tournaments or the normal match, the referee in the scorecard text.
